name: Durotar's Dire Drought: Collect Water fills Dirgran's Pitcher in both pools outside Razor Hill (#7548, #7542)
contract: Reports #7548, #7542 and #6521: using Empty Dirgran's Pitcher (558973) in the pool south of Razor Hill, by the bridge, answers 'You can't do this here'. #7548 was filed at map 1, 215.83, -4750.88, 6.63 and #6521 at 215.43, -4751.65, 6.63; #6037 says on live the pitcher filled at 214.13, -4753.89, 6.64.

The quest text sends the player to 'one of the pools outside Razor Hill'. The server terrain has two pools there: the west pool around 209, -4693 (water 12.78) and the south pool around 216, -4755 (water 7.40).

The pitcher casts Collect Water (267033), whose spell_scripts row creates Full Dirgran's Pitcher (558974). A conditions row lets it work only within 6 yards of a [TG] Water Tauren (162949) trigger, and before the fix only the west pool and the kennel trough had one.
A fill in either pool must give Full Dirgran's Pitcher. In Razor Hill itself, where #7542 was filed (367.34, -4728.41), there is no water and the pitcher must stay empty.

steps.label: Let spawn AI settle
Fixture: orc is on Durotar's Dire Drought, objectives not done
Fixture: drop the delivery pitcher the quest fixture grants
Accepting the quest gives the empty pitcher
The orc starts without a full pitcher
orc joins the world phase the water triggers are spawned in
orc stands in the south pool where #7548 was filed
Let the grid load
orc uses the empty pitcher in the south pool
The south pool fills the pitcher
Filling used up the empty pitcher
Empty the hands for the next fill
Fixture: hand the empty pitcher back for the next fill
orc stands in the south pool where #6037 filled it on live
Wait out the pitcher's 5 s cooldown
orc uses the empty pitcher at the #6037 spot
The #6037 spot fills the pitcher
Filling used up the empty pitcher
Empty the hands for the west pool
Fixture: hand the empty pitcher back for the next fill
orc stands in the west pool
Let the grid load and the pitcher's 5 s cooldown pass
orc uses the empty pitcher in the west pool
The west pool still fills the pitcher
Filling used up the empty pitcher
Empty the hands for the inn pool
Fixture: hand the empty pitcher back for the next fill
orc stands at the pool outside the Razor Hill inn (#8507)
Let the grid load and the pitcher's 5 s cooldown pass
orc uses the empty pitcher at the inn pool
The inn pool fills the pitcher
Filling used up the empty pitcher
Empty the hands for the dry check
Fixture: hand the empty pitcher back for the next fill
orc stands in Razor Hill where #7542 was filed, away from any water
Let the grid load and the pitcher's 5 s cooldown pass
orc tries the empty pitcher in town
Wait past the 2 s cast
Town has no water, so the pitcher stays empty
The empty pitcher is kept for later fills
